verses.2815: ʾirḥal liṭaybata lā taʾumma siwāhā faʿasāka ʾan taḥẓā biruʾuyati ṭaha
verses.2816: faʾidhā waṣalta lahā ktaḥil min turbihā huwa ʾithmidu l-ʿaynayni wahwa jalāhā
verses.2817: dāru l-hanā, fīhā l-ghinā, wakadhā l-munā dāru l-ḥabībi qulūbunā tahwāhā
verses.2818: hiyā ṭaybatu ṭābat liṭībi ʾuṣūlihā wamadīnatu rabbu s-samā sammāhā
verses.2819: hiyā munyatu l-ʾalbābi miftāḥu l-hudā fānhaḍ ʾilayhā wāghtanim lil-qāhā
verses.2820: hiyā lujjahu khaḍrāʾu wasṭa mafāzati fīhā l-ḥayāʾu hiyā llatī tarʿāhā
verses.2821: hiyā durratu bayḍāʾu khāliṣata turā faʿalayka ʾan tasʿā lahā fatarāhā
verses.2822: fal-ʿaynu qarrat ʿindamā naẓarat lahā wāstabsharat faraḥā bimā ʾātāhā
verses.2823: wal-qalbu qad sakana ḍṭirābu lahībihi lammā raʾā mā fī l-biqāʿi siwāhā
verses.2824: kullu r-rawāʾiḥi qad zakat min ṭībihā fajamīʿuhā ṭābat liṭībi shadhāhā
verses.2825: hayhāta ʾayna l-misku min nafaḥātihā mā l-misku ʾillā jīfatu bidimāhā
verses.2826: lā taḥsabi l-miska dh-dhakiyyā katurbihā hayhāta ʾayna l-misku min rayyāhā
verses.2827: hayyā faʾin tabghi t-taṭayyuba yā fatā faʾadim ʿlā s-sāʿāti lathma tharāhā
verses.2828: kullu l-ʾamākini ḥaythu kunna kanuqṭati fī baḥri ṭaybata nāzilīna ḥimāhā
verses.2829: mā mithla ṭaybata manzilu wakafā bihā fakhrā ḥulūlu l-muṣṭafā birubāhā
verses.2830: wallāhi lā shāʾu yuʿādiluhā ʾidhā dhukirat walā yashfī s-siqāma siwāhā
verses.2831: man ḥalla fīhā fāza minhā bil-munā maʾawā l-gharībi lahu l-hanā bithawāhā
verses.2832: lā yakhsha min ḍaymi ʾaqāma waʾin ghadā huwa ʾāminu wallāhi ḥaythu ʾatāhā
verses.2833: waʾidhā jafāhā raghbaha falahu l-ʿanā kal-kīri tanfī khubthahā waṣadāhā
verses.2834: lā yastaqirru qarārahu fī ghayrihā ʾabadā yahīmu bihā walā yansāhā
verses.2835: hiyā baldatu llāhi llatī qad khaṣṣahā bil-ghaythi wal-ghawthi lladhī ʾaḥyāhā
verses.2836: willāhu sharrafahā waʾaʿẓama turbahā yashfī mina l-ʾasqāmi nashra shadhāhā
verses.2837: sharafat ʿalā kulli l-biqāʿi jamīʿihā hadhā ṣ-ṣaḥīḥu faʿinda dhā natabāhā
verses.2838: hiyā madhhabī fīhā nashaʾatu wamawṭinī falahā hawaytu wamā ʾaladhdha hawāhā
verses.2839: wallāhi lā ʾabghī bihā badala walaw ḍāqa l-maʿāshu walaw ʾakaltu nawāhā
verses.2840: jazama l-jamīʿu biʾanna turbaha ʾaḥmadi khayru l-biqāʿi bidhā naqūlu shifāhā
verses.2841: lā shakka fīhi walā khafāʾa walā mtirā wallāhu sharrafa ʾarḍahā wasamāhā
verses.2842: l-badru fīhā wal-kawākibu ḥawlahu suruju tuḍīʾu liman ʾatā biḥimāhā
verses.2843: qismā bikhāliqihā lladhī ʾanshā l-warā mā miltu ʿanhā sāʿata ʾansāhā
verses.2844: kayfa s-suluwwu wamahjatī fī turbihā ʾabadā ʾaḥinnu lidhikrihā waliqāhā
verses.2845: wallāhi lā ʾaslū walaw ʿadhala lladhī yalqā famā qalbī ranā lisiwāhā
verses.2846: ʾinnī ʾidhā shāʾa l-ʾilahu ʾakūnu min sukkānihā waʾadhūqu min laʾawāhā
verses.2847: faʾaqim bihā yā sāmiʿā liḥadīthihi fan-nafsu ʾin ṣabarat tanālu munāhā
verses.2848: hiyā dāru khayri l-mursalīna fanūruhā yazhū ʿalā l-qamarayni ḥīna ʾatāhā
verses.2849: wal-minbaru l-ʿālī l-muʿaẓẓamu qadruhu lammā ʿalāhu ghadā bihi yatabāhā
verses.2850: wabihā l-baqīʿu waʾahluhu fī rawḍaḍi shuhadāʾuhā fī jannati maʾawāhā
verses.2851: wabihi kadhāka sirāju ṭaybata fī d-dujā ʿuthmāna dhū n-nūrayni sāda walāhā
verses.2852: wabihi l-jalīlu fadhāka ʿammu nabiyyinā ʿabbāsu maʿ ḥasani ʿalā biʿalāhā
verses.2853: wabihi r-raḍiyyatu ʾummu sayyidinā ʿaliy wakadhā ḥalīmatu ʾin mararta tarāhā
verses.2854: wakadhāka ʿammahu khayri man waṭaʾa th-tharā fī qabbahi sharufat raqat liʿulāhā
verses.2855: wanisāʾu khayri l-mursalīna qubūruhum mashhūratu wasṭa l-baqīʿi tarāhā
verses.2856: wabihā mawāḍiʿu shādahā khayru l-warā waʾatā ʾilayhā rākibā wamashāhā
verses.2857: minhā kadhalika masjidu jamʿiyyatu naḥwa ṭ-ṭarīqi tarāhu fī ʾadnāhā
verses.2858: wabihā qarīẓaḍu walliwā maʿ ḥājiri wabihā muṣallī l-ʿīdi maʿ suqyāha
verses.2859: wabihā l-ʿaqīqu biʾarḍi zahri qad zahat ʾāthāruhu fīhā famā ʾazhāhā
verses.2860: wabihā l-masājidu ʿinda silʿi wan-niqā wal-qiblatayni wamasjidi wal-hā
verses.2861: wahunāka masjidu rāyati fī qilʿahi khafaqat riyāḥu n-naṣri min ʾaʿlāhā
verses.2862: ʾuḥudu yalīhi yuḥḥibunā wanuḥḥibuhu hārūnu fīhi biqurbihi shuhadāhā
verses.2863: waʾidhā mararta tarā hunālika masjidā lil-fasḥi yusmā fī ṭ-ṭarīqi ʿalāhā
verses.2864: wakadhāka ḥamzatu dhū sh-shujāʿati min samā ʿammu r-rasūli fadhāka min shuhadāhā
verses.2865: waḥidhāhu ʿabdūllahi sayyidunā sumī bībni lijaḥshi nāma fī baṭḥāhā
verses.2866: wahunālika sh-shuhadāʾu muʿtaraku lahum fī fisḥahi talqāhumu birubāhā
verses.2867: yastabshirūna biniʿmahi min rabbihim fariḥat nufūsuhumu bimā ʾātāhā
verses.2868: lā khawfa ʿindahumu walā ḥuznu walā karbu wahum fī n-nāsi hum ʾaḥyāhā
verses.2869: wabihā l-manāʾiru wal-manāzilu kulluhum waqubā hunāka wamasjidu wal-hā
verses.2870: wabihā mina l-ʾābāri sabʿu massahā khayru l-ʾanāmi bikaffihi faʿalāhā
verses.2871: ghurusu ʾarīsu, rūmatu, wabiḍāʿatu bawṣā waʿihnu, bikru, mā ʾasnāhā
verses.2872: wakadhāka māʾidatu turā manqūrata wasṭa l-khalāʾi ʾidhā mararta tarāhā
verses.2873: hadhā lladhī qad qultu baʿḍa ṣifātihā lā ʾastaṭīʿu linaʿtihā wasanāhā
verses.2874: yā zāʾirā qif bid-diyāri waḥayyihā wāsbil dumūʿa l-ʿayni ḥīna tarāhā
verses.2875: wāsʾal ʾilahaka ghafra dhanbika kullihi tuʿṭāhu ʿinda ḥabībi qalbika ṭaha
